post_title: How many Japanese educational facilities will the MHLW report as fully or partially closed due to influenza-like illness this season, cumulative through the week ending October 25, 2026?

question.title: How many Japanese educational facilities will the MHLW report as fully or partially closed due to influenza-like illness this season, cumulative through the week ending October 25, 2026?
question.description:
Japan's 2026/27 influenza season began unusually early, with authorities declaring a nationwide epidemic on August 28, 2026 — among the earliest on record since tracking began in 1999. Flu normally peaks between December and March in Japan.

The MHLW publishes weekly surveillance data every Friday from September through roughly the end of March. One component is the "インフルエンザ様疾患発生報告（学校欠席者数）" report, which counts educational facilities (nurseries/保育所, kindergartens/幼稚園, elementary, junior-high, and senior-high schools) that implemented a temporary closure — full school closure (休校), grade closure (学年閉鎖), or class closure (学級閉鎖) — due to influenza-like illness. The headline "施設数" figure is a cumulative season-to-date count.

Reported cumulative facility counts this season climbed steeply: 937 for the week ending October 4 (reported October 10), and about 1,703 as of October 11. The average number of flu cases per sentinel medical institution reached 11.35 in the week of September 28–October 4, exceeding the "caution" threshold of 10 and roughly seven times the level a year earlier, with case counts rising in 44 of 47 prefectures. Okinawa (37.07) exceeded the "warning" threshold of 30.

For reference, in the prior 2025/26 season the cumulative count reached 2,307 facilities as of early November 2025. Given the earlier and steeper 2026/27 trajectory, the cumulative total by the week ending October 25, 2026 is highly uncertain and depends on how quickly the surge continues or plateaus.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) "インフルエンザ様疾患発生報告（学校欠席者数）" (Influenza-like illness occurrence report / school absentee numbers), published weekly and compiled at the National Institute for Health Crisis Management (JIHS) page: https://id-info.jihs.go.jp/surveillance/idwr/diseases/influenza/school/flulike.html . The resolution value is the cumulative season total facility count ("施設数", the sum of nurseries, kindergartens, elementary, junior-high, and senior-high schools that implemented a full school closure (休校), grade closure (学年閉鎖), or class closure (学級閉鎖)) shown in the report covering the week ending October 25, 2026 (令和8年第44週, October 19–25, 2026). For example, if the report shows a cumulative facility total of 4,250, this resolves as 4250. The report for that week is expected to be published on or about October 30, 2026 (the MHLW press release list is at https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/kenkou_iryou/kenkou/kekkaku-kansenshou01/houdou_00025.html ).
question.fine_print: The figure used is the cumulative season-to-date total facility count ("施設数") as first published for the week ending October 25, 2026 (令和8年第44週), not a later-revised value. If the report presents separate columns for 休校 (full closure), 学年閉鎖 (grade closure), and 学級閉鎖 (class closure) rather than a single total, the resolution value is their sum. If publication is delayed, resolution waits for the report; if MHLW/JIHS permanently cease publishing this report and the value cannot be obtained from [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), the question is annulled.
